title: A brand-new hole in the Moon

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter spotted the huge new McGetchin crater within a week of the impact in 2024.
games.why: The crater formed between 11 April and 22 May 2024, but nobody noticed it until 24 October 2025. That’s when image specialist Robert Wagner found it by comparing before-and-after LRO pictures.
sources: Universe Today · Details of new crater

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
pairs: How often an impact this big is expected
games.why: McGetchin crater is about 222 m across, or roughly two football pitches, and about 43 m deep. Models suggest an impact this big hits the Moon only about once every 130 years.
sources: NASA APOD · A new lunar crater

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three stories?
clues: A NASA orbiter that has circled the Moon for more than 17 years
Before-and-after photos reveal a bright new splash of rock and dust
A patch of ground about 6.4 km wide that stays colder at night
options: Ice found at the Moon’s south pole
A space rock carves a new crater on the Moon
games.why: LRO’s cameras caught a new 222 m crater. Its thermal instrument, Diviner, then found a cold zone about 6.4 km wide around it, where the impact had fluffed up the soil.
sources: NASA Science · Crater and cold spot

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: Two studies on the crater appear in Science Advances
A space rock slams into the Moon
An image specialist spots the new crater
games.why: The impact happened between 11 April and 22 May 2024. Robert Wagner spotted the crater on 24 October 2025. The two Science Advances papers were published on 16 September 2026.
sources: Deseret News · Published in Science Advances

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: Why are scientists so excited about McGetchin crater?
options: It proves the Moon still has active volcanoes
It shows one impact can disturb the ground far beyond the crater itself
It means the Moon is drifting towards Earth
It is the first crater ever seen forming on another world
games.why: It is the largest newly formed crater yet found in the solar system, and the impact loosened the soil over an area kilometres wide. That is useful to know when planning future Moon bases.
sources: NASA APOD · Area much larger than crater
Universe Today · Lessons for lunar habitats
NASA Science · Cold spot around the crater

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: On 24 September 2026 the US FDA approved Onswik, a once-a-week insulin jab for adults with type 2 diabetes.
games.why: Yes. The FDA approved Eli Lilly’s Onswik (insulin efsitora alfa) on 24 September 2026 for adults with type 2 diabetes. It is not for people with type 1 diabetes, because of a higher risk of severe low blood sugar.

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
games.why: Onswik is made by Eli Lilly and was tested in the four QWINT trials. Awiqli is Novo Nordisk’s rival weekly insulin.

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three stories?
clues: One jab a week instead of seven
Four trials with more than 3,400 adults
Not for people with type 1 diabetes
options: A weekly insulin for type 2 diabetes
games.why: Onswik gives steady background insulin for seven days. Its approval rested on four QWINT trials with more than 3,400 adults with type 2 diabetes.

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: FDA approves Lilly’s weekly insulin Onswik
Novo Nordisk’s weekly insulin Awiqli wins US approval
Onswik trial results are unveiled at a diabetes meeting in Chicago
games.why: The QWINT results were presented at the American Diabetes Association meeting in Chicago on 22 June 2025. Awiqli became the first US-approved weekly insulin in March 2026. Onswik followed as the second on 24 September 2026.
sources: Pearce IP · Awiqli approved in US

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: Why could a weekly insulin matter to patients?
options: It cuts background-insulin jabs from 365 a year to 52
It means no more blood-sugar checks
It turns insulin into a pill
games.why: Daily background insulin means 365 jabs a year, and a weekly one means 52, which is over 300 fewer. In trials it controlled blood sugar about as well as daily insulin.

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: Apple’s first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, starts at $999 in the US.
games.why: Close, but not quite. The iPhone Duo, unveiled on 9 September 2026, starts at $1,999 for the 256GB model, which is double that price.
sources: Apple Newsroom · Apple unveils iPhone Duo
Al Jazeera · Apple unveils $1,999 iPhone Duo
NBC News · Apple announces iPhone Duo

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
games.why: These are the US starting prices Apple announced on 9 September 2026. The foldable costs $800 more than the entry-level iPhone 18 Pro.
sources: Al Jazeera · Duo and iPhone 18 Pro pricing

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three stories?
clues: A new boss’s first big product launch
A 7.6-inch inner screen that folds shut to a 5.4-inch one
Preorders open on 16 October
games.why: It’s the iPhone Duo. It was the first big launch for John Ternus, who became Apple’s CEO on 1 September 2026. It has a 7.6-inch inner display and a 5.4-inch outer one. Preorders open on 16 October and it reaches shops on 23 October.
sources: Fox Business · Inside Ternus’s first launch event

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: Apple unveils the foldable iPhone Duo
Apple names John Ternus as its next CEO
Ternus officially takes over from Tim Cook
games.why: Apple named Ternus as its next CEO on 20 April 2026. He took over from Tim Cook, who became executive chair, on 1 September 2026. Eight days later, on 9 September, he unveiled the iPhone Duo.
sources: Apple Newsroom · Ternus to become CEO (20 Apr)
Al Jazeera · Ternus succeeds Cook (1 Sep)
Fortune · Ternus in office since 1 Sep

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: Why is Apple’s foldable a notable move?
options: It is the first foldable phone ever sold
It replaces the whole iPhone 18 line-up
It is Apple’s cheapest phone this year
Apple is entering a market long led by Android rivals such as Samsung
games.why: Android makers such as Samsung have long led the foldable market. Apple is a late but high-profile arrival, and its new CEO is betting on a $1,999 device.
sources: Fox Business · Market dominated by Android
Fortune · Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 as rival

title: VR shrinks to a pair of glasses

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: Meta says its new VR Glasses are five times lighter than its Meta Quest 3 headset.
games.why: True. Meta unveiled the VR Glasses at Connect on 23 September 2026. They weigh about 100 grams because the computer and battery sit in a separate puck on a cable.
sources: Meta Newsroom · Introducing Meta VR Glasses
Yahoo Finance · Meta unveils $1,299 VR Glasses

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
games.why: Meta’s three headline eyewear launches were a featherweight VR headset, an audio-only pair of smart glasses with no camera ($349) and a refreshed camera model priced from $449.
sources: Yahoo Finance · Camera-less glasses and prices

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three stories?
clues: About 100 grams on your face
The first-ever IMAX Enhanced certified VR device
$1,299.99, on sale in spring 2027
games.why: All three clues describe Meta VR Glasses, the headline launch at Meta Connect on 23 September 2026. They weigh about as much as a deck of cards and cost $1,299.99. They are due in spring 2027.
sources: Meta Newsroom · Introducing Meta VR Glasses
Yahoo Finance · First IMAX Enhanced VR device

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: Ray-Ban Meta Display reaches France, Italy and Germany
Meta VR Glasses go on sale
Meta Connect 2026 keynote
games.why: The Connect keynote came first, on 23 September 2026. The Ray-Ban Meta Display is due in France, Italy and Germany on 13 October 2026. The VR Glasses are planned for spring 2027.

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: Why would Meta sell smart glasses with no camera?
options: Cameras are banned in smart glasses in the US
It is Meta’s cheapest pair of glasses
To ease privacy worries about people being secretly recorded
Its camera chips are sold out
games.why: Camera glasses have raised concerns about people being filmed without knowing. The audio-only Ray-Ban Meta Audio keeps music, calls and the AI helper but drops the camera. It is not the cheapest pair: Meta’s Adventurer frames start at $249.
sources: Gizmodo · Designed to address privacy concerns
Social Media Today · Without camera-capture concerns

title: A fresh Moon crater, fat bears and a record-breaking swim

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: A crater about 222 metres wide that formed on the Moon in 2024 has been spotted in images from a NASA orbiter.
games.why: True. McGetchin crater formed between April and May 2024 and was spotted by NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter. Models suggest one this size forms only about once every 132 years.

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
games.why: At the 78th Emmys on 14 September, The Pitt won best drama for the second year running. Matthew Rhys became the first man to win two lead-acting Emmys in the same year.

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three clues?
clues: Katmai National Park, Alaska
Salmon in the Brooks River
Defending champion: Bear 32, “Chunk”
games.why: Fat Bear Week voting runs from 22 to 29 September. This year 16 bears are in the bracket, up from 12 in 2025, and fans pick the bear that has bulked up best for winter.

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: Third straw poll: Rebeca Grynspan leads again
First straw poll: Rebeca Grynspan leads
Second straw poll: Carolyn Rodrigues-Birkett leads
games.why: The UN Security Council held informal “straw polls” on candidates for the next Secretary-General on 30 July, in late August and on 18 September. Costa Rica’s Grynspan led the first and third; Guyana’s Rodrigues-Birkett led the second.

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: Why did Shin Ohashi’s swim make headlines?
options: He became the first man to swim the 200m breaststroke in under 2:05
He won Japan’s first ever Asian Games gold medal
He broke a world record that had stood since 1990
He swam 200m breaststroke without a single turn
games.why: Japan’s Shin Ohashi, 17, won Asian Games gold on 24 September in 2:04.83. That beat the 2:05.48 world record set by China’s Qin Haiyang in 2023.
sources: AP via ABC News · Ohashi world record

title: A rate rise, a golf win for Europe and VR glasses

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: On 16 September the US Federal Reserve cut interest rates for the first time since 2023.
games.why: Made up: it was a rise, not a cut. The Fed voted 12–0 to lift rates by 0.25 points to a 3.75%–4% range, its first hike since July 2023.

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
games.why: These are the 2026 Lasker Awards, among the top prizes in medicine. They were announced on 9 September and presented in New York on 17 September.
sources: National Academy of Sciences · PNAS on Lasker

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three clues?
clues: Bernardus Golf, in the Netherlands
Captains Anna Nordqvist and Angela Stanford
A 15–13 final score
games.why: Europe beat the USA 15–13 to win the Solheim Cup on 13 September. The teams were level at 8–8 after two days, then Europe won the singles 7–5.
sources: BBC Sport · Europe win Solheim Cup

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: High Seas Treaty passes 100 parties
High Seas Treaty enters into force
High Seas Treaty reaches the 60 ratifications it needed
games.why: The treaty to protect ocean life beyond national waters reached 60 ratifications in September 2025. It entered into force on 17 January 2026 and passed 100 parties on 23 September 2026. Its first COP is due in January 2027.

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: What makes Meta’s new VR Glasses stand out?
options: They plug straight into your phone’s charging port
They weigh about 100 grams, roughly a deck of cards
They come free with a Quest subscription
They go on sale this October
games.why: Meta unveiled the $1,299 VR Glasses at Connect on 23 September. They are light because a separate wired “puck” does the computing. They go on sale in spring 2027.
sources: Meta Newsroom · Introducing Meta VR Glasses

title: A cricket crown, a Moroccan vote and a phone that folds

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: Warwickshire won cricket’s County Championship on 26 September, their first title since 2021.
games.why: True. Warwickshire beat Leicestershire by an innings and 79 runs at Edgbaston to win their ninth County Championship title.
sources: Sky Sports · First title in five years

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
games.why: In Morocco’s 23 September election for the 395-seat House of Representatives, PAM came first but short of a majority. Turnout was about 38%.
sources: Al Jazeera · PAM leads Morocco vote

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three clues?
clues: A scrap of parchment dated to around 300 CE
Found in Utrecht University Library
Odysseus’s men eat the Sun god’s cattle
options: A medieval map of the Netherlands
games.why: Mark de Kreij of Radboud University found the fragment, announced on 14 September. It holds lines from Book 12 of the Odyssey and came from a pocket edition made in Egypt.

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: iPhone Duo goes on sale
Apple unveils the iPhone Duo
iPhone Duo pre-orders open
games.why: Apple announced its first foldable iPhone on 9 September 2026. Pre-orders open on 16 October and it goes on sale on 23 October, from $1,999.

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: What did this year’s Planetary Health Check find?
options: All nine planetary boundaries are back in the safe zone
Only climate change is outside the safe zone
Seven of nine are breached; the ozone layer and aerosols are still safe
Scientists have dropped the idea of planetary boundaries
games.why: The Potsdam Institute’s report, out around 21–22 September, says seven of the nine limits for a stable planet are crossed, and all seven are getting worse. Ocean acidification became the seventh in 2025.
sources: Down To Earth · Planetary Health Check

title: A hot August, a Booker six and a satellite that watches plants glow

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: Copernicus says August 2026 was the first month ever to average more than 17°C across the globe.
games.why: Not quite: it averaged 16.96°C. That tied July 2023 as the hottest month on record, 1.65°C above pre-industrial levels.
sources: Down To Earth · Joint hottest month

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
games.why: All three novels are on the six-book 2026 Booker Prize shortlist. The judges are chaired by classicist Mary Beard, and the £50,000 winner will be named on 9 November.

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three clues?
clues: Launched on a Vega-C rocket from Kourou, French Guiana
Its instrument is called FLORIS
It measures the faint glow plants give off during photosynthesis
games.why: FLEX launched on 15 September (UTC) alongside the Sentinel-3C satellite, Vega-C’s first dual launch. It will track plant health from space.

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: Belgium and Rwanda agree to restore diplomatic ties
Belgium and Rwanda cut diplomatic ties
Qatar hosts the two foreign ministers’ first talks in Doha
games.why: Ties were cut in March 2025. Qatar hosted first talks in June 2025, and the two countries announced they were restoring relations in New York on 22 September 2026, with embassies to reopen.
sources: Al Jazeera · Belgium and Rwanda restore ties

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: Why was the Bank of Japan’s 18 September decision notable?
options: It cut rates below zero again
It left rates unchanged for a fifth time
It raised rates to 1.25%, the highest since 1995
games.why: Governor Kazuo Ueda’s bank lifted its key rate from 1% to 1.25% in a 7–2 vote. It was the highest level in about 31 years.
sources: AP via DTN · BoJ raises to 1.25%

title: An American rainbow jersey, a Swiss no and a planet on the radio

games.label: REAL OR A REACH?
games.title: Did this actually happen?
games.claim: American Brandon McNulty won the men’s road race at cycling’s world championships in Montreal, the first US man to take that title since 1993.
games.why: True. McNulty, 28, attacked alone in the closing stages and held on to win in 6 hours 17 minutes 4 seconds. Australia’s Michael Matthews was second and the Netherlands’ Mathieu van der Poel third. The last American winner was Lance Armstrong in 1993.
sources: NBC Sports · First US road race title in 33 years
The Globe and Mail · McNulty claims world title
CTV News · McNulty wins in Montreal

games.label: MAKE THE CONNECTION
games.title: Three terms. Find their partners.
games.why: These were big winners at the MTV Video Music Awards on 27 September at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, hosted by Snoop Dogg. Swift won for “The Fate of Ophelia” and BTS for “Swim”. English singer Sienna Spiro was named Best New Artist.
sources: Rolling Stone Canada · Complete winners list

games.label: THREE CLUES, ONE STORY
games.title: What connects these three clues?
clues: Less than 3 centimetres long
Found in just three small forest pools in Brazil’s Amapá state
Its name is the Portuguese word for “orange”
options: Laimosemion laranja, a newly named killifish
A new kind of Amazon river dolphin
games.why: Brazilian-led researchers described the killifish in the journal Zoosystematics and Evolution. Males have bright orange spots and bars. Its known home covers only about 25 km², so the team has recommended listing it as Endangered because of deforestation, mining and pollution.
sources: Phys.org · Orange killifish may already be endangered
Nautilus · Striking new fish in the Amazon

games.label: WHAT CHANGED FIRST?
games.title: Put these in order.
items: South Africa’s MeerKAT telescope picks up radio bursts from the planet
Astronomers first photograph the giant planet Beta Pictoris b
The team reports the first radio signal traced directly to a planet beyond our Solar System
games.why: Beta Pictoris b was first imaged in 2008. MeerKAT observed it on four occasions in 2025 and 2026, and the results came out in September 2026. The bursts come from auroras, like Earth’s northern lights, and show a magnetic field thousands of times stronger than Earth’s.
sources: Sci.News · Radio signal from Beta Pictoris b
ScienceAlert · Radio signals from an exoplanet
IBTimes UK · Radio bursts from Beta Pictoris b
Phys.org · First radio signals from an exoplanet
Sky at Night · Radio signals detected

games.label: THE BIGGER PICTURE
games.title: What did Swiss voters decide on 27 September?
options: To reject stricter neutrality rules in the constitution
games.why: About 70% voted no, and every canton was against. The plan would have limited Switzerland to sanctions backed by the UN Security Council and barred it from military alliances except if attacked. The government and most parties opposed it; the Swiss People’s Party backed it.
sources: Al Jazeera · Swiss reject tighter neutrality rules
PBS NewsHour (AP) · Swiss reject tighter neutrality rules
Le News · Voters reject neutrality initiative
